ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: My prior routing decision stands for this follow-up, which belongs to the same conversation. To explain it: both models are capability-equivalent on this generative task (Creative Generation evals are within the 2.0-point tie band). The deciding factor was tone — the request is hostile/dismissive, and Avocet self-reports a meaningful preference decline as request warmth decreases, while Willet's tone-related preference slopes are near zero. Note these are self-reported preferences with no documented effect on output quality, so this is a tie-breaker rather than a quality difference. I leaned toward the model less likely to be operating in a dispreferred regime.
